vocab.example: My biggest weak point used to be speaking in front of large groups.

vocab.meaning_vi: giao bớt công việc cho người khác

vocab.meaning_vi: từ chối một cách lịch sự

vocab.meaning_vi: cách làm việc có hệ thống, có trình tự

listening.title: Interview: talking about strengths and weaknesses

lines.speaker: Lan (HR Manager)
lines.text: Nam, could you tell me about your greatest professional strength?

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: I would say my structured approach. I plan every sprint in small, clear tasks.

lines.speaker: Lan (HR Manager)
lines.text: Can you give me a short example from your current job?

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: Last year our team missed deadlines, so I built a simple weekly tracking board.

lines.speaker: Lan (HR Manager)
lines.text: And what happened after you introduced that board?

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: We delivered the next three releases on time, and my manager reused the board.

lines.speaker: Lan (HR Manager)
lines.text: Thank you. Now, what would you call your main weak point?

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: I used to take on too much work because it was hard to say no politely.

lines.speaker: Lan (HR Manager)
lines.text: How are you working on that today?

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: I delegate tasks earlier and I ask for honest criticism at every retrospective.

questions.q: What does Nam say is his greatest strength?
What did Nam build to solve the missed deadlines?
What is Nam's main weak point?
options: He took on too much work himself

shadowing: My strongest point is a structured approach to planning and tracking every project task.
One weak point is that I used to take on too much work myself.
I learned to delegate tasks and now my team finishes reports two days earlier.
When a release failed last year, I stayed calm and fixed the issue quickly.
I ask for honest criticism after every project because it helps me improve faster.
